comparison_rule: Metrics are comparable only when dataset/query/judgment definitions permit comparison. Match cutoff, eligibility, representation/model and timing boundary as appropriate.

workloads.purpose: Narrow required-evidence/context/stub regressions; no complete graded ranking universe.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Compare preserved V0-V2 routes on the same two needs, eligibility and context policy; execution/timing boundary must match.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not equate two-task evidence success with later macro NDCG or general answer quality.

workloads.purpose: Compare overlap/BM25/WAND and Chapter 10 exact binary cosine on an inspected lexical workload.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement sequence across Chapter 09, 11, 12 or stress workloads; no model gain from geometry alone.

workloads.purpose: Frozen encoder versus BM25 on new authored embedding probes; Chapter 13 uses it for materialization parity.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement sequence across Chapter 09, 11, 12 or stress workloads; no model gain from geometry alone.

workloads.purpose: Same-model exact oracle versus lexical and ANN variants on inspected stress slices; geometric and judged recall stay separate.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement sequence across Chapter 09, 11, 12 or stress workloads; no model gain from geometry alone.

workloads.purpose: Query-adapter training and dev selection followed by document-target/new-query holdout; source families overlap.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Frozen/adapted/BM25 on the same 11 test queries after checkpoint freeze; compare validation separately.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not compare 25 queries as a single fully judged set, reuse test for selection, or infer unseen-family/domain transfer.

workloads.purpose: Teach dev-select-freeze-test parameter methodology with separate authored questions.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Compare the twenty settings only on dev for selection, and frozen selected/default only on the six test queries.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not treat original inspected Chapter 09 cases as this held-out test; do not compare this score with original Chapter 09 as an engine improvement.

workloads.purpose: Hand-authored scoring mechanism fixture, not a neural model benchmark.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Sparse surface/expanded on identical sparse fixture; pooled/MaxSim on identical token fixture.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No score comparison with Chapter 13 or across the sparse/token fixtures; no trained SPLADE/ColBERT performance claim.
